_readme: Every entry point anyone may call, on the Diamond and on the contracts shipped beside it, with what backs it (#2984).
Checked by contracts/script/check-permissionless-steps.mjs (predeploy-check step 1e; the keeper typecheck runs its --ledger-only half). Its header defines each class.
An open entry point with no row fails the check, and so does a row for a function that is gated or gone. Add a row with the function that adds the entry point.
